components.name: Scan button
components.description: Main action with hover, press and keyboard feedback.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:26px;min-height:48px;min-width:173px;padding:11px 18px;border:1px solid var(--blue,#244dcc);border-radius:8px;background:var(--blue,#244dcc);color:var(--white,#fff);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;transition:background-color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--blue-dark,#1939a5);box-shadow:0 5px 12px -6px #244dcc80}.ds-primary svg{transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-primary:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}.ds-primary:active{background:#142d84;box-shadow:none}.ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#456deb); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-primary:disabled{background:#6379b6;border-color:#6379b6;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary svg{transition:none}.ds-primary:hover svg{transform:none}}

components.name: Cancel button
components.css: .ds-cancel{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#202c47)}.ds-cancel:hover{background:var(--soft-blue,#edf2ff)}.ds-cancel:active{background:#dce5ff}.ds-cancel:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#456deb); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text action
components.css: .ds-text{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px;padding:6px 2px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--blue,#244dcc);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:transparent;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-text:hover{text-decoration-color:currentColor}.ds-text:active{color:var(--blue-dark,#1939a5)}.ds-text:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#456deb); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-text:disabled{color:#737e91;text-decoration:none;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Example control
components.description: Synthetic sample selection, represented here in its selected state.
components.css: .ds-example{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:40px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);border-radius:7px;background:var(--white,#fff);color:#41506b;transition:color 160ms,background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms}.ds-example:hover{border-color:#a6b8eb;color:var(--blue,#244dcc);background:#f6f8ff}.ds-example[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--soft-blue,#edf2ff);border-color:#91a9ef;color:var(--blue-dark,#1939a5)}.ds-example:active{background:#dce5ff}.ds-example:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#456deb); outline-offset:4px; }.ds-example:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Email editor
components.description: Labeled, resizable plain-text input with muted placeholder and keyboard focus.
components.html: Plain text works best
components.css: .ds-editor{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;max-width:520px;border:1px solid #bbc7dc;border-radius:10px;color:var(--ink,#202c47);background:var(--white,#fff);transition:border-color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms}.ds-editor:focus-within{border-color:var(--blue,#244dcc);box-shadow:0 3px 12px -6px #244dcc55}.ds-editor label{display:block;padding:14px 14px 4px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600}.ds-editor textarea{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:220px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 16px 16px;font:inherit;font-size:.9375rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ink,#202c47);background:transparent;resize:vertical;caret-color:var(--blue,#244dcc)}.ds-editor textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#596780)}.ds-editor textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #456deb;outline-offset:-5px}.ds-meta{display:block;padding:8px 16px 12px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted,#596780)}

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Current destination and current-tab count badge.
components.html: ScannerThis session 2
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:32px;min-height:80px;background:var(--white,#fff);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--muted,#596780);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav .ds-current{color:var(--blue,#244dcc)}.ds-current::after{position:absolute;content:"";bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--blue,#244dcc)}.ds-nav span{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:21px;height:21px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--soft-blue,#edf2ff);color:var(--blue,#244dcc);font-size:.75rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#456deb); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Workspace surface
components.description: Shared white composer and pale blue analysis container.
components.html:
Give it a second look.

Paste a message below, or explore a sample.

Analysis

Your scan results will appear here.
components.css: .ds-workspace{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);border:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);border-radius:18px;background:var(--white,#fff);box-shadow:0 12px 36px -24px #213e7b3d;color:var(--ink,#202c47)}.ds-composer{padding:32px;min-width:0}.ds-analysis{min-width:0;padding:28px;background:#eef3ff;border-left:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);border-radius:0 17px 17px 0}.ds-workspace h2{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:680;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-workspace p{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted,#596780);margin:0}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-workspace{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.ds-analysis{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);border-radius:0 0 17px 17px}}

components.name: Session result row
components.description: Flat selectable result row with text-backed semantic color.
components.css: .ds-session{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;display:grid;width:100%;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 1fr 20px;align-items:center;gap:20px;text-align:left;padding:18px 12px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dce2ef);color:var(--ink,#202c47);background:transparent;transition:background-color 150ms}.ds-safe{color:var(--safe,#23633d)}.ds-session:hover{background:#e8eefc}.ds-session[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--soft-blue,#edf2ff)}.ds-session:active{background:#dce5ff}.ds-session:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#456deb); outline-offset:4px; }@media(max-width:760px){.ds-session{grid-template-columns:1fr 20px;gap:5px 12px;padding:14px 8px}.ds-session span{grid-column:1}.ds-session svg{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/4}}

narrative.northStar: Cobalt actions and cool white surfaces
narrative.overview:
This existing scanner uses cobalt actions, cool white surfaces and a quiet blue analysis region. Its interface is a compact working tool for a school demonstration: the input, primary action and model output remain easy to locate.

A system sans-serif stack gives headings, controls and numerical results one consistent voice. Thin boundaries and restrained shadows distinguish interactive areas; outline SVG icons support labels without replacing them.
keyCharacteristics: Cobalt primary actions with cool neutral boundaries.
System sans-serif hierarchy and tabular numerical scores.
Editor and analysis share one responsive workspace.
Semantic result colors are accompanied by text and icons.

rules.name: Action Color
rules.body: Use cobalt for primary actions, current navigation and focus-related emphasis; reserve green and red for result and error semantics.

rules.name: Readable State
rules.body: Keep placeholder text at the muted text color and communicate errors, selection and results with more than color alone.

rules.name: One Type Family
rules.body: Use the system sans-serif stack throughout this operating interface, with weight and size establishing hierarchy.

dos: Do use the cobalt action palette and cool white or pale blue surfaces.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, descriptive labels and text alongside result colors.
Do stack the editor before analysis on narrow screens and allow labels to wrap.
Do use the authored outline SVG icon family consistently.
Do retain the model caveat and clearly label synthetic examples.
donts: Don't use semantic green or red as an unrelated decorative accent.
Don't present loading as a numerical percentage or imply model certainty.
Don't introduce unsupported school branding, benchmarks or testimonials.
Don't make mobile heading line breaks depend on the desktop composition.
